memory_candidates.content: snacks.nvim terminal/window mechanics relevant to any repositionable snacks terminal in this Neovim config: snacks.terminal derives its terminal id from cmd, cwd, env and vim.v.count1 ONLY -- never from win options -- so changing a window's position/size and re-toggling reuses the same terminal object and re-shows it at the ORIGINAL position. To reposition a live terminal without killing its job, mutate the win object's own opts (opts.position/height/width) and then call term:hide() followed by term:show(): M:open_win() re-reads self.opts.position at open time, and M:hide() is close({buf = false}), which preserves the terminal buffer and its running process. Separately, for a split position (bottom/left/right) open_win() consumes only one dimension (vertical and opts.width or opts.height), so mapping a single size fraction onto both height and width is harmless; for float BOTH apply, yielding a square window, so a single size fraction should be omitted for float and left to the float style defaults. snacks.terminal.get() defaults to create = true, so a pure lookup must pass create = false.
